use default

humble() -> Pipe[long] is
    let found = LIST()
    found.add(1L)

    let next_index = LIST()
    let factors = [2L, 3L, 5L, 7L]

    for _ in factors do
        next_index.add(0)
    od

    do
        yield found[found.count - 1]

        let smallest mut = found[next_index[0]] * factors[0]

        for which in 1..factors.count do
            let candidate = found[next_index[which]] * factors[which]

            if candidate < smallest then
                smallest = candidate
            fi
        od

        for which in 0..factors.count do
            if found[next_index[which]] * factors[which] == smallest then
                next_index[which] = next_index[which] + 1
            fi
        od

        found.add(smallest)
    od

let first_fifty =
    humble() |> take(50) |> map(value => "{value,5}") |> collect_list()

write_line("the first fifty humble numbers:")

for row in 0..5 do
    write_line(first_fifty[row * 10..row * 10 + 10] |> join(""))
od

let widths = LIST()

for _ in 1::20 do
    widths.add(0)
od

for value in humble() do
    let width = "{value}".length

    if width > 16 then break fi

    widths[width - 1] = widths[width - 1] + 1
od

write_line("")
write_line("how many humble numbers have each number of digits:")

for width in 1::16 do
    write_line("  {width,2} digits: {widths[width - 1]}")
